title: Zephyr C: TDMA slot duration not derived from ceil(max airtime)+50ms guard (spec 09 14.8)
description: Spec 09 14.8 R-09-141: at each configured data rate, slot duration MUST be at least ceil(maximum permitted PHY-payload airtime in milliseconds) + 50 ms guard; not derived from a typical packet; 255B SF10 profile gives 2295.808 ms airtime -> 2346 ms minimum slot. Classification: DIVERGENT - C lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link.h:88 LICHEN_TDMA_SLOT_MS is 250 (used tdma.c:72,156), which satisfies the formula only for payloads far below the 255B profile max; the ceil(airtime)+50 formula exists as executable code in NO language (encoded as precomputed constants TDMA_SLOT_MS=2346 in python/src/lichen/timing/sfn.py:12-13 and rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs:97); 2295.808 ms literal appears nowhere. Guard enforcement itself is implemented+tested in C (tdma.c:183-195 tdma_tx_allowed, LICHEN_TDMA_GUARD_MS=50; vectors ccp_tdma.json data_window_last_millisecond/guard_boundary_start). Suggested placement: either derive LICHEN_TDMA_SLOT_MS from configured max PHY payload + datarate at init, or document the C profile max payload that justifies 250 ms; add the airtime+guard formula to lichen (C) and a production sfn/duty helper.
